thesis.headline: Can synthetic heartbeats help a model detect atrial fibrillation?

strip.normalNote: Even beats, each with a P wave before the spike.
strip.afNote: Uneven beats, no P wave, a restless baseline.
strip.disclaimer: Illustrative trace drawn by this app. Not patient data.

steps.title: Wavelet domain
steps.detail: The ECG is moved into an invertible wavelet domain, so whatever is generated there converts back to a signal.

steps.title: WGAN-GP
steps.detail: A WGAN-GP learns to generate synthetic ECG in that domain.

steps.title: EfficientNet-B0
steps.detail: A transfer-learning classifier for atrial fibrillation, on the MIT-BIH AF Database.

thesis.finding: The synthetic data gave no detectable gain. The classifier works; the generated heartbeats did not make it better. That is the result.

desk.headline: Desk: a life desk run by nightly agents.
desk.summary: Cloud agents read the inbox and the calendar every night and write a brief into a private git vault. Desk is the native Mac app that reads it: what is due, what needs a reply, what to confirm. It holds no credentials, renders untrusted text as plain text, and changes nothing without a click.
desk.screensNote: Screens drawn from invented demo data.
desk.architectureNote: One writer per file · no server · no tokens in the app
